description: A Java class that manages GPS location data by fetching from, caching, and updating a database. It provides methods to retrieve location points for a specific day, clear data for a day, and add new points, optimizing database access with an internal cache.

classes.name: LocationDataManager
classes.description: This class manages GPS location data, providing caching, retrieval, and database updates for location points on a per-day basis.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LocationEntry objects for a specific day, using cache if available; otherwise, loads from the database.

methods.name: clearPoints
methods.description: Deletes all location data entries for a specified day from both cache and database.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new LocationEntry point to the database and cache, avoiding duplicates.
